title: 第5章 云江仙的白月光！
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
寝殿内。

    老太监青符忽然眯起眼眸，断眉上挑，目光疑惑的在寝殿周围扫视了一圈。

    无果后，他的视线下意识落在了龙榻方向，但很快便面露讥讽地摇了摇头。

    如此大片区域的灵气消失，怎么可能与一个废物纨绔有关。

    估计，又是哪位贵妃精进了……

    秦然悠然坐在床上，将青符的表情尽收眼底。

    在寝宫周围，有很多强者监视着一举一动，有各大势力安插的探子，有贵妃娘娘们的走狗，也有一些大夏神朝的遗臣。

    青符明面上只是个唯唯诺诺的老太监，但秦然却清楚这老家伙的真正底细。

    能跟在先帝身边贴身侍奉，作为大夏太监副总管，青符又岂会是平庸之辈？

    先帝早年曾荡平过一座魔宗，其宗门势力极度强盛，放眼整个大夏境内，也能排到前十之列。

    其中最强者，乃是一个成名许久的老魔头。

    这魔头凶名赫赫，手段高绝，先帝也是费了不少手段才将其拿下。

    那人正是眼前这生有断眉的瘦高太监——青符！

    先帝拿捏到了青符的家人作为软肋，并许以五百年之期归还其自由，所以青符才老老实实的在宫里当太监。

    青符如今蛰伏着当中立派，但日后在小太监的协助下软肋解除后，成为了小太监身边的最强走狗之一。

    真正的大杀器！

    秦然笑了。

    在先帝陨落后，宫中便没人知道这老太监的家人在哪里。

    很不巧，他知道。

    不过软肋暂时不在身边，想要利用起来，还需要一些其他因素的帮助……

    秦然内视着自身如今的状态。

    【姓名：云江仙】

    【修为：飞天境九重天】

    【体质：种玉仙身】

    【功法：云宫掠天术（帝阶）】

    在耗光了玄黄之血，以及所有启灵石后，他成功获得了特殊体质。

    现今大陆上共有千种特殊体质，种玉仙身刚好排到第五百名。

    【种玉仙身】

    【介绍】：可通过一滴神魔精血，在体内培育出一尊妖兽或神魔，拥有者可随时进行神魔变，化为神魔之躯，拥有神魔全部能力。

    一般来说，特殊体质都是直接改造人体强度，无限增强气血或某一方面能力。

    而种玉仙身则是在体内豢养一尊神魔！

    因为神魔妖兽有亿万种，强弱亦有高下之分，所以种玉仙身是一种强度难以评估的体质。

    它可以为至强之一！

    也可以是最弱体质！

    所以最终评定为排名五百！
content_en:
In the sleeping hall.

The old eunuch Qing Fu suddenly narrowed his eyes, raised his eyebrows, and glanced around the dormitory in confusion.

After getting no results, his eyes subconsciously fell in the direction of the dragon couch, but he quickly shook his head with a sarcastic look on his face.

How could the disappearance of spiritual energy in such a large area be related to a loser?

I guess which of the noble concubines has improved...

Qin Ran sat leisurely on the bed, taking in Qing Fu's expression.

Around the palace, there were many powerful people monitoring every move, including spies deployed by major forces, lackeys of noble concubines, and some relics of the Great Xia Dynasty.

On the surface, Qing Fu was just a submissive old eunuch, but Kieran knew the true background of this old guy.

Being able to serve the late emperor personally, as the deputy chief eunuch of Daxia, how could Qing Fu be a mediocre person?

The late emperor once defeated a demon sect in his early years, and its sect was extremely powerful, ranking among the top ten in the entire Daxia territory.

The strongest among them is an old devil who has been famous for a long time.

This demon had a great reputation and superb methods, and the late emperor spent a lot of time to capture him.

That person is the tall and thin eunuch with a broken eyebrow in front of him - Qing Fu!

The late emperor found Qingfu's family as his weakness and promised to return his freedom within five hundred years, so Qingfu worked honestly as a eunuch in the palace.

Qing Fu is currently dormant as a neutral faction, but in the future, with the help of the little eunuch, he will become one of the strongest lackeys around the little eunuch after his weakness is lifted.

A real killer!

Kieran smiled.

After the death of the late emperor, no one in the palace knew where the old eunuch's family was.

Unfortunately, he knew it.

However, the weakness is not around for the time being. If you want to take advantage of it, you need the help of some other factors...

Qin Ran looked inwards at his current state.

[Name: Yunjiangxian]

[Cultivation: Flying Heaven Realm Ninth Level]

[Physique: Jade Immortal Body]

[Kung Fu: Cloud Palace Sky-plundering Technique (Emperor Level)]

After consuming all Xuanhuang's blood and all the Spiritual Enlightenment Stones, he successfully obtained a special physique.

There are now thousands of special physiques on the mainland, and the Jade Immortal Body ranks right at the 500th.

【Planting Jade Immortal Body】

[Introduction]: A drop of the essence and blood of gods and demons can be used to cultivate a monster or god and demon in the body. The owner can transform into a god and demon at any time, transform into the body of a god and demon, and possess all the abilities of a god and demon.

Generally speaking, special physiques directly modify the strength of the human body and infinitely enhance qi, blood or certain abilities.

And the jade immortal body is raising a god and demon in the body!

Because there are hundreds of millions of kinds of gods, demons and monsters, and there are different levels of strength and weakness, the Jade Immortal Body is a physique whose strength is difficult to evaluate.

It can be one of the strongest!

It can also be the weakest physique!

So the final evaluation was ranked 500!
